stories.title: OpenCode AI Coding Agent Flaw Lets Malicious Websites Execute Code on Developer Machines
stories.description: A critical attack path in OpenCode, the open-source AI coding agent, could allow a malicious website to execute commands on a developer’s computer.

stories.title: Bitget Backend Breach Drains $387.5 Million as DPRK-Linked Launderers Expose Themselves
stories.description: Cryptocurrency exchange Bitget has begun restoring withdrawals after attackers exploited its backend wallet infrastructure on September 24, stealing approximately $387.5 million from hot and warm wallets.

stories.title: ShinyHunters Bypasses WAF Protections to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells
stories.description: ShinyHunters exploits a critical Oracle PeopleSoft flaw to bypass WAFs and plant web shells, targeting organizations across multiple sectors.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a Microsoft SharePoint code injection vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-65660, to its KEV Catalog after evidence showed the flaw was being exploited in attacks.

stories.title: Prison Sentence for Former US Soldier Who Hacked AT&T and Verizon
stories.description: Cameron John Wagenius was sentenced to 70 months in prison for stealing information from the wireless carriers.

stories.title: Webinar: How to Govern AI Agents, Reduce Excessive Access, and Control Shadow AI
stories.description: Join Okta’s webinar to learn how to govern AI agents, control shadow AI, and reduce excessive access with stronger identity controls.

stories.title: Carbonato Botnet Compromises Docker Hosts to Deploy Telegram-Controlled Hermes AI Agent
stories.description: Carbonato targets unauthenticated Docker daemons, installs Hermes Agent, and uses Telegram to run operator-directed AI-generated commands.

stories.title: JADEPUFFER-Linked Attackers Used Compromised Service Principals to Delete Azure Resources
